skill_name: Describe the most interesting thing that you have learned about whales in one paragraph.
workflow: Whales are one of the most amazing creatures on our planet! They are the largest living mammals and have adapted to nearly every ocean on Earth. I find one of the most fascinating facts about whales is that they produce different types of sounds to communicate with one another.
